rule.text: No, the line cannot pass the price match. The invoice unit price of ₹1,218 exceeds the PO unit price of ₹1,200 by ₹18 per unit, resulting in a total excess of ₹18,000 for 1,000 units. Under SOP v4.0, the allowable tolerance is the lower of 1% of the PO line value (₹12,000) and ₹500, which is ₹500. Since ₹18,000 > ₹500, the line fails and must be held with exception PRICE_VAR.
